Arachnids' Ascent#000.src: Hm... ah, {u}! There you are. I was just about to send someone to fetch you.

Arachnids' Ascent#001.src: Our preparations are complete, and it's time for the assault on the spider den! With you here, we'll just need to wait for-...

Arachnids' Ascent#002.src: If {u} is here, I take it that means today's the day we strike at the spiders?

Arachnids' Ascent#003.src: 'course, the roots ain't an option. Lucky this ol' corrupted spring chose to pop up out here, eh? Scientific mystery, it is- but none o' that's our concern.

Arachnids' Ascent#005.src: Ah, good! You can see the pickle we're in, hmm? We've tried everything to get these poor souls out, but the damnned web is like glue!

Arachnids' Ascent#006.src: Cob filled you in on my reasoning, yes? We need to get through these webs somehow... and, well, this seemed simpler than the other option.

Arachnids' Ascent#008.src: So what do we do now? You mentioned another option- what was that about? What about it made it difficult?

Arachnids' Ascent#009.src: Then what's the catch? You would have tried this first if it were that simple.

Arachnids' Ascent#010.src: The mountain is infested with spiders, even more so than {p}. Our few attempts at scouting it out have been met with extreme hostility.

Arachnids' Ascent#011.src: You've been rocketed by the great web.

Arachnids' Ascent#012.src: Well, here we are! ...The heat's gotten more intense up here. Come on, let's find what we're looking for, before I over-

Arachnids' Ascent#016.src: You've returned! I trust you found something that can help us get through these webs?

Arachnids' Ascent#017.src: Talk to Admiral Aegis in the {p} Barracks at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Arachnids' Ascent#017.dst: Habla con el almirante Aegis en los barracones de {p}, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Arachnids' Ascent#018.src: Let's see... ah, {u}! There you are. I was just about to send someone to fetch you.
Arachnids' Ascent#018.dst: Veamos... ¡ah, {u}! Aquí estás. Iba a mandar a alguien a buscarte.
Arachnids' Ascent#018.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Arachnids' Ascent#019.src: Follow me- we have a conversation to have in my office. It's on the top floor of the barracks.
Arachnids' Ascent#019.dst: Sígueme, tenemos que hablar en mi despacho. Está en la última planta de los barracones.
Arachnids' Ascent#019.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Arachnids' Ascent#020.src: ...ahem. Now that we're here, we can discuss the matter of {p}.
Arachnids' Ascent#020.dst: ...ejem. Ya que estamos aquí, hablemos del asunto de {p}.
Arachnids' Ascent#020.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Arachnids' Ascent#021.src: Our preparations are complete, and it's time for the assault on Nivla's spider den! With you here, we'll just need to wait for-...
Arachnids' Ascent#021.dst: ¡Los preparativos están listos y es hora de asaltar la guarida de arañas de Nivla! Contigo aquí, solo falta esperar a...
Arachnids' Ascent#021.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Arachnids' Ascent#022.src: Admiral- we're here! Sorry we're late, we were sparring in the training room and lost track of time...
Arachnids' Ascent#022.dst: ¡Almirante, ya estamos! Perdón por el retraso, estábamos entrenando y se nos fue el tiempo...
Arachnids' Ascent#022.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#023.src: If {u} is here, I take it that means today is the day we strike at the spiders?
Arachnids' Ascent#023.dst: Si {u} está aquí, ¿significa que hoy atacamos a las arañas?
Arachnids' Ascent#023.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#024.src: Indeed it is. Now, you three are to be the force which will fight through their den and clear out as many of those spiders as you can. For that, you'll need support.
Arachnids' Ascent#024.dst: Así es. Vosotros tres seréis la fuerza que se abrirá paso por su guarida y eliminará todas las arañas que pueda. Para ello, necesitaréis apoyo.
Arachnids' Ascent#024.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Arachnids' Ascent#025.src: We've sent out several soldiers ahead of time to make preparations on site. You'll want to first speak to Private Cob on the {p}, who will have supplies for you.
Arachnids' Ascent#025.dst: Hemos enviado a varios soldados por delante para preparar el terreno. Primero hablad con el soldado Cob en {p}; tendrá suministros para vosotros.
Arachnids' Ascent#025.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Arachnids' Ascent#026.src: I expect this mission will hold some danger, but I trust the three of you will be able to deal with anything you come across. Good luck, soldiers!
Arachnids' Ascent#026.dst: Esta misión entrañará cierto peligro, pero confío en que los tres podréis con lo que os encontréis. ¡Suerte, soldados!
Arachnids' Ascent#026.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Arachnids' Ascent#027.src: Yes, sir. We'll do our best.
Arachnids' Ascent#027.dst: Sí, señor. Haremos lo que podamos.
Arachnids' Ascent#027.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#028.src: These spiders won't stand a chance! Let's get going.
Arachnids' Ascent#028.dst: ¡Esas arañas no tienen nada que hacer! Pongámonos en marcha.
Arachnids' Ascent#028.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#029.src: Speak to Private Cob in the Savannah at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to receive supplies.
Arachnids' Ascent#029.dst: Habla con el soldado Cob en la sabana, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}], para recibir suministros.

Arachnids' Ascent#030.src: 'ey there, chaps! You lot must be the spider killin' force, eh?
Arachnids' Ascent#030.speaker: Private Cob

Arachnids' Ascent#031.src: That's us! The Admiral told us you had supplies to give us?
Arachnids' Ascent#031.dst: ¡Esos somos! El almirante dijo que tenías suministros para nosotros.
Arachnids' Ascent#031.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#032.src: That I do! Now, 'fore I send ya off, there's been sum news from the Cap'n!
Arachnids' Ascent#032.dst: ¡Y tanto! Pero antes de mandaros pa'llá, ¡hay noticias del capi!
Arachnids' Ascent#032.speaker: Private Cob

Arachnids' Ascent#033.src: Buncha terrorised citizens been found right next to the bloomin' den! Trapped in a sticky old web, they were.
Arachnids' Ascent#033.dst: ¡Han encontrao un montón de vecinos aterraos al lao de la guarida! Atrapaos en una telaraña pegajosa, estaban.
Arachnids' Ascent#033.speaker: Private Cob

Arachnids' Ascent#034.src: Priority number one is gettin' them out, before takin' on the den. But nothin' can get through the web!
Arachnids' Ascent#034.dst: Lo primero es sacarlos de ahí antes de atacar la guarida. ¡Pero no hay na' que atraviese la telaraña!
Arachnids' Ascent#034.speaker: Private Cob

Arachnids' Ascent#035.src: No fire, no magic... nothin' has broken through. The cap'n decided- 'ey, why not try some lava? 's hotter than fire, anyway.
Arachnids' Ascent#035.dst: Ni fuego, ni magia... na' la ha roto. Y el capi va y dice: eh, ¿y si probamos con lava? Que quema más que el fuego, digo yo.
Arachnids' Ascent#035.speaker: Private Cob

Arachnids' Ascent#036.src: Point is. Along with all your supplies 'n whatnot, ya've gotta bring along some lava for the cap'n. Magically contained, o' course!
Arachnids' Ascent#036.dst: A lo que iba. Además de los suministros y demás, tenéis que llevarle lava al capi. ¡Contenida con magia, claro!
Arachnids' Ascent#036.speaker: Private Cob

Arachnids' Ascent#037.src: Sure, that sounds easy enough. A bit of extra work, but we were heading in that direction anyway.
Arachnids' Ascent#037.dst: Claro, parece bastante fácil. Es algo de trabajo extra, pero íbamos en esa dirección de todos modos.
Arachnids' Ascent#037.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#038.src: That's the spirit! If ya want the best route to the den, follow that road with the burn marks. It'll send ya straight to the cap'n!
Arachnids' Ascent#038.dst: ¡Así me gusta! Si queréis el mejor camino a la guarida, seguid la senda con marcas de quemaduras. ¡Os llevará derechitos al capi!
Arachnids' Ascent#038.speaker: Private Cob

Arachnids' Ascent#039.src: Bring the supplies to Captain Enduyn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Arachnids' Ascent#039.dst: Lleva los suministros al capitán Enduyn en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Arachnids' Ascent#040.src: At ease, soldiers! You're the three Aegis told me to look out for, aren't you? Have you spoken to Cob yet?
Arachnids' Ascent#040.dst: ¡Descansen, soldados! Sois los tres que Aegis me pidió que esperara, ¿verdad? ¿Habéis hablado ya con Cob?
Arachnids' Ascent#040.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#041.src: We have, and we've brought supplies. As well as... lava, I think?
Arachnids' Ascent#041.dst: Sí, y traemos suministros. Y también... lava, creo.
Arachnids' Ascent#041.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#042.src: Ah, good! You can see the pickle we're in, hmm? We've tried everything to get those poor souls out, but the damned web is like glue!
Arachnids' Ascent#042.dst: ¡Ah, bien! Ya veis el lío en que estamos, ¿eh? Lo hemos probado todo para sacar a esas pobres almas, ¡pero la maldita telaraña es como pegamento!
Arachnids' Ascent#042.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#043.src: Now, let's see here... If I cast a spell on it like this, then...
Arachnids' Ascent#043.dst: A ver... Si le lanzo un hechizo así, entonces...
Arachnids' Ascent#043.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#045.src: So, what do we do now? You mentioned another option- what was that about? What about it made it difficult?
Arachnids' Ascent#045.dst: ¿Y ahora qué hacemos? Mencionó otra opción, ¿cuál era? ¿Qué la hacía tan difícil?
Arachnids' Ascent#045.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#046.src: Right. You may have noticed on your way here, but the nest is at the base of {p}, a dormant volcano.
Arachnids' Ascent#046.dst: Bien. Quizá lo notasteis de camino, pero el nido está al pie de {p}, un volcán dormido.
Arachnids' Ascent#046.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#047.src: Legends speak of incredible magic granted by the mountain- that of protection, incinerating any who dare go against it.
Arachnids' Ascent#047.dst: Las leyendas hablan de una magia asombrosa de la montaña: protección que calcina a quien ose desafiarla.
Arachnids' Ascent#047.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#048.src: These are only stories, of course. It's very unlikely the mountain actually could grant such magic. However... there may be some truth in the legend.
Arachnids' Ascent#048.dst: Solo son cuentos, claro. Es muy poco probable que la montaña pueda otorgar tal magia. Sin embargo... puede que la leyenda tenga algo de verdad.
Arachnids' Ascent#048.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#049.src: So what's the catch? You would have tried it first if it were that simple.
Arachnids' Ascent#049.dst: ¿Y cuál es la pega? Si fuera tan fácil, lo habría probado primero.
Arachnids' Ascent#049.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#050.src: The mountain is infested with spiders, even more so than {p}. Our few attempts at scouting it out have shown they're incredibly hostile towards intruders.
Arachnids' Ascent#050.dst: La montaña está infestada de arañas, aún más que {p}. En nuestros pocos intentos de explorarla, se han mostrado muy hostiles con los intrusos.
Arachnids' Ascent#050.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#051.src: As though they're protecting something, I assume?
Arachnids' Ascent#051.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#052.src: Indeed. So, here's the plan... If you enter the mountain, the spiders will quickly try to move inside to stop you. I'll need one of you to stay here with me to fight them off.
Arachnids' Ascent#052.dst: Exacto. Este es el plan... Si entráis en la montaña, las arañas correrán hacia dentro para deteneros. Necesito que uno de vosotros se quede aquí conmigo para contenerlas.
Arachnids' Ascent#052.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#053.src: So two of us take on the volcano, and two stay behind. Got it! {u}, you should be part of the Mount Wynn group. But then, Tasim, which of us should go with them?
Arachnids' Ascent#053.dst: O sea, dos vamos al volcán y dos se quedan. ¡Entendido! {u}, tú deberías ir al grupo de Mount Wynn. Pero entonces, Tasim, ¿cuál de los dos debería ir?
Arachnids' Ascent#053.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#054.src: Why don't we let {u} decide? Which of us do you want to join you in the volcano?
Arachnids' Ascent#054.dst: ¿Por qué no dejamos que decida {u}? ¿Con cuál de nosotros quieres entrar en el volcán?
Arachnids' Ascent#054.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#055.src: Alright! We'll handle the volcano then. Captain, Tasim, don't die out here!
Arachnids' Ascent#055.dst: ¡Muy bien! Nosotros nos encargamos del volcán. ¡Capitán, Tasim, no os muráis!
Arachnids' Ascent#055.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#056.src: Alright. We'll fight through the spiders in the mountain, then. Captain, Aledar, good luck!
Arachnids' Ascent#056.dst: De acuerdo. Nos abriremos paso entre las arañas de la montaña. ¡Capitán, Aledar, suerte!
Arachnids' Ascent#056.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#057.src: Then take more time. But don't take too long- we don't want the spiders to realize we're planning something.
Arachnids' Ascent#057.dst: Pues tómate más tiempo. Pero no tardes mucho: no queremos que las arañas noten que tramamos algo.
Arachnids' Ascent#057.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#058.src: Decide who to bring with you into Mount Wynn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Arachnids' Ascent#058.dst: Decide a quién llevar contigo a Mount Wynn en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Arachnids' Ascent#059.src: So, who do you want to join you to fight through Mount Wynn?
Arachnids' Ascent#059.dst: Bueno, ¿a quién quieres a tu lado para abrirte paso por Mount Wynn?
Arachnids' Ascent#059.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#060.src: Alright! We'll handle the volcano then. Captain, Tasim, don't die out here!
Arachnids' Ascent#060.dst: ¡Muy bien! Nosotros nos encargamos del volcán. ¡Capitán, Tasim, no os muráis!
Arachnids' Ascent#060.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#061.src: Alright. We'll fight through the spiders in the mountain, then. Captain, Aledar, good luck!
Arachnids' Ascent#061.dst: De acuerdo. Nos abriremos paso entre las arañas de la montaña. ¡Capitán, Aledar, suerte!
Arachnids' Ascent#061.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#062.src: Then take more time. But don't take too long- we don't want the spiders to realize we're planning something.
Arachnids' Ascent#062.dst: Pues tómate más tiempo. Pero no tardes mucho: no queremos que las arañas noten que tramamos algo.
Arachnids' Ascent#062.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#063.src: Enter Mount Wynn and reach the summit through the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Arachnids' Ascent#063.dst: Entra en Mount Wynn y llega a la cima por la cueva de [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Arachnids' Ascent#064.src: ...Wow, it's hot in here! That makes sense, I guess, given what we're here for. Let's reach the top as quickly as we can.
Arachnids' Ascent#064.dst: ...¡Vaya, qué calor hace aquí dentro! Tiene sentido, supongo, por lo que venimos a buscar. Lleguemos arriba lo antes posible.
Arachnids' Ascent#064.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#065.src: W-woah! You felt that too, right? What's going-
Arachnids' Ascent#065.dst: ¡Ho-hala! Lo has notado tú también, ¿no? ¿Qué está pasa-
Arachnids' Ascent#065.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#066.src: We've got to run for it! Come on, jump!
Arachnids' Ascent#066.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#067.src: That... that was a close one. Phew! Can't believe we made it out in one piece. I think we're near the top, too.
Arachnids' Ascent#067.dst: Eso... eso ha estado cerca. ¡Uf! No me creo que hayamos salido de una pieza. Y creo que ya estamos cerca de la cima.
Arachnids' Ascent#067.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#068.src: Well, here we are! ...The heat's gotten more intense up here. Come on, let's find out what we're looking for, before I over-
Arachnids' Ascent#068.dst: ¡Bueno, aquí estamos! ...Aquí arriba el calor es aún peor. Vamos, busquemos lo que hemos venido a buscar antes de que me desma-
Arachnids' Ascent#068.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#071.src: Ack! We should have known it wouldn't be that easy. Alright, let's take down this spider and get what we came for!
Arachnids' Ascent#071.dst: ¡Ay! Debimos saber que no sería fácil. ¡Venga, matemos a esta araña y llevémonos lo que vinimos a buscar!
Arachnids' Ascent#071.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#072.src: Well, there it is. We have what we need to burn through those webs!... I hope.
Arachnids' Ascent#072.dst: Bueno, ahí está. ¡Ya tenemos con qué quemar esas telarañas!... Eso espero.
Arachnids' Ascent#072.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#073.src: The spider mentioned a queen... I guess that's what we'll be facing in their nest, then.
Arachnids' Ascent#073.dst: La araña mencionó a una reina... Supongo que a eso nos enfrentaremos en su nido.
Arachnids' Ascent#073.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#074.src: Alright, let's get back to Tasim and the captain!
Arachnids' Ascent#074.dst: ¡Venga, volvamos con Tasim y el capitán!
Arachnids' Ascent#074.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#075.src: ...I can hear the spiders already. We'll need to fight through them if we want to reach the top. Let's get going, we don't want to take too long.
Arachnids' Ascent#075.dst: ...Ya oigo a las arañas. Tendremos que abrirnos paso entre ellas si queremos llegar arriba. Vamos, no hay que tardar demasiado.
Arachnids' Ascent#075.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#076.src: H-huh? That shaking, it's almost like-
Arachnids' Ascent#076.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#077.src: What are those spiders doing!? {u}, come on, we need to move!
Arachnids' Ascent#077.dst: ¡¿Qué están haciendo esas arañas?! ¡{u}, vamos, hay que moverse!
Arachnids' Ascent#077.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#078.src: ...That was closer than it should have been. The spiders must be real desperate to protect whatever it is they have up here, huh? Let's keep going.
Arachnids' Ascent#078.dst: ...Eso ha estado más cerca de lo debido. Las arañas deben de estar desesperadas por proteger lo que tengan aquí arriba, ¿eh? Sigamos.
Arachnids' Ascent#078.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#079.src: It was a tough climb, but we made it... It's, uh, very hot up here. So- what was it we were looking for-
Arachnids' Ascent#079.dst: Ha sido una subida dura, pero lo logramos... Aquí arriba hace, eh, muchísimo calor. Bueno, ¿qué era lo que buscába-
Arachnids' Ascent#079.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#082.src: Of course it wouldn't be that easy... Alright, {u}, let's do what we came here for. Let's claim that magic, and burn through the webs!
Arachnids' Ascent#082.dst: Claro, no iba a ser tan fácil... Venga, {u}, hagamos aquello a lo que hemos venido. ¡Reclamemos esa magia y quememos las telarañas!
Arachnids' Ascent#082.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#083.src: I guess that's that taken care of. We'll be able to burn through that web and save the villagers!
Arachnids' Ascent#083.dst: Supongo que eso ya está. ¡Podremos quemar esa telaraña y salvar a los aldeanos!
Arachnids' Ascent#083.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#084.src: You heard the spider mention a queen, right? We'll probably have to defeat it in it's nest to stop the spiders, once and for all.
Arachnids' Ascent#084.dst: Oíste a la araña mencionar a una reina, ¿verdad? Seguramente tendremos que vencerla en su nido para acabar con las arañas de una vez por todas.
Arachnids' Ascent#084.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#085.src: We should probably get going back down the mountain. We don't want to keep Aledar and the Captain waiting.
Arachnids' Ascent#085.dst: Deberíamos ir bajando la montaña. No hagamos esperar a Aledar y al capitán.
Arachnids' Ascent#085.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#086.src: Return to Captain Enduyn with the flame at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Arachnids' Ascent#086.dst: Vuelve con la llama junto al capitán Enduyn en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Arachnids' Ascent#087.src: You've returned! I trust you found something that can help us pass through these webs?
Arachnids' Ascent#087.dst: ¡Habéis vuelto! Supongo que habéis encontrado algo que nos ayude a atravesar estas telarañas.
Arachnids' Ascent#087.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#088.src: We did! We fought off a spider at the summit, and claimed a magical flame.
Arachnids' Ascent#088.dst: ¡Sí! Vencimos a una araña en la cima y conseguimos una llama mágica.
Arachnids' Ascent#088.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#089.src: Excellent! Now, give it here. Let's see if we can't get these villagers free... watch out, folks! It might get a little warm for a moment...
Arachnids' Ascent#089.dst: ¡Excelente! Venga, dádmela. A ver si logramos liberar a estos aldeanos... ¡cuidado, gente! Puede que haga un poco de calor un momento...
Arachnids' Ascent#089.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#090.src: Great work, soldiers. With these villagers out we can turn our focus to the main den.
Arachnids' Ascent#090.dst: Buen trabajo, soldados. Con los aldeanos fuera, podemos centrarnos en la guarida principal.
Arachnids' Ascent#090.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#091.src: If you're prepared, I don't see any reason to hold back. Good luck in there, soldiers! Let's stop this spider blight once and for all.
Arachnids' Ascent#091.dst: Si estáis preparados, no veo motivo para esperar. ¡Suerte ahí dentro, soldados! Acabemos con esta plaga de arañas de una vez por todas.
Arachnids' Ascent#091.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#092.src: We'll do our best, Captain. Aledar, {u}, let's head down to the den entrance.
Arachnids' Ascent#092.dst: Haremos lo que podamos, capitán. Aledar, {u}, bajemos a la entrada de la guarida.
Arachnids' Ascent#092.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#093.src: You've returned! I trust you found something that can help us pass through these webs?
Arachnids' Ascent#093.dst: ¡Habéis vuelto! Supongo que habéis encontrado algo que nos ayude a atravesar estas telarañas.
Arachnids' Ascent#093.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#094.src: We did, yes. There was a powerful spider at the peak, which was making use of this magical flame.
Arachnids' Ascent#094.dst: Sí, así es. En la cima había una araña poderosa que usaba esta llama mágica.
Arachnids' Ascent#094.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#095.src: Excellent! Now, give it here. Let's see if we can't get these villagers free... watch out, folks! It might get a little warm for a moment...
Arachnids' Ascent#095.dst: ¡Excelente! Venga, dádmela. A ver si logramos liberar a estos aldeanos... ¡cuidado, gente! Puede que haga un poco de calor un momento...
Arachnids' Ascent#095.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#096.src: Great work, soldiers. With these villagers out we can turn our focus to the main den.
Arachnids' Ascent#096.dst: Buen trabajo, soldados. Con los aldeanos fuera, podemos centrarnos en la guarida principal.
Arachnids' Ascent#096.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#097.src: If you're prepared, I don't see any reason to hold back. Good luck in there, soldiers! Let's stop this spider blight once and for all.
Arachnids' Ascent#097.dst: Si estáis preparados, no veo motivo para esperar. ¡Suerte ahí dentro, soldados! Acabemos con esta plaga de arañas de una vez por todas.
Arachnids' Ascent#097.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#098.src: We'll do our best, Captain. Aledar, {u}, let's head down to the den entrance.
Arachnids' Ascent#098.dst: Haremos lo que podamos, capitán. Aledar, {u}, bajemos a la entrada de la guarida.
Arachnids' Ascent#098.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#099.src: H-hah! F-freedom! No m-more c-creepy crawlies... Just me a-and my... mushrooms.
Arachnids' Ascent#099.dst: ¡J-ja! ¡L-libertad! Se acabaron los b-bichos... Solo yo y m-mis... setas.
Arachnids' Ascent#099.speaker: Yahya

Arachnids' Ascent#100.src: We did it! We killed the spider queen! {p} is safe from that threat now!
Arachnids' Ascent#100.dst: ¡Lo logramos! ¡La reina araña ha muerto! ¡{p} ya está libre de esa amenaza!
Arachnids' Ascent#100.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#101.src: We- we did! That was... intense. But we succeeded in the end!
Arachnids' Ascent#101.dst: ¡Lo... lo logramos! Ha sido... intenso. ¡Pero al final lo conseguimos!
Arachnids' Ascent#101.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#102.src: ...So, what now? We completed the mission, so we should report back to the Admiral, but... what's after that?
Arachnids' Ascent#102.dst: ...¿Y ahora qué? Hemos cumplido la misión, así que deberíamos informar al almirante, pero... ¿y después?
Arachnids' Ascent#102.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#103.src: I guess we'll have to figure that out. I know I still want to help defend the province, but beyond that... I don't know.
Arachnids' Ascent#103.dst: Supongo que tendremos que averiguarlo. Sé que aún quiero ayudar a defender la provincia, pero aparte de eso... no lo sé.
Arachnids' Ascent#103.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#104.src: ...Yeah, alright. Well, hey, let's all meet back at {p} and celebrate! We deserve it after that whole ordeal.
Arachnids' Ascent#104.dst: ...Sí, vale. Bueno, oye, ¡reunámonos todos en {p} y celebrémoslo! Nos lo merecemos después de este calvario.
Arachnids' Ascent#104.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#105.src: That sounds good, yeah. {u}, we'll rest up here a little, but we'll meet you back at the barracks soon.
Arachnids' Ascent#105.dst: Me parece bien, sí. {u}, descansaremos aquí un poco, pero nos vemos pronto en los barracones.
Arachnids' Ascent#105.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#106.src: Well, here we are! Back at the barracks, after a successful mission. It feels a little... unreal, you know?
Arachnids' Ascent#106.dst: ¡Bueno, aquí estamos! De vuelta en los barracones tras una misión cumplida. Parece un poco... irreal, ¿sabes?
Arachnids' Ascent#106.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#107.src: I know what you mean. But, well, we did good! We managed to make the woods safer for the people living there.
Arachnids' Ascent#107.dst: Sé lo que quieres decir. Pero, bueno, ¡lo hicimos bien! Conseguimos que el bosque sea más seguro para quienes viven allí.
Arachnids' Ascent#107.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#108.src: We did! And now, we celebrate! Here, let's all some {p} Whiskey for the occasion.
Arachnids' Ascent#108.dst: ¡Así es! ¡Y ahora, a celebrarlo! Tomad, bebamos todos un poco de whisky de {p} para la ocasión.
Arachnids' Ascent#108.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#109.src: So, what are you two planning to do next? I think I'll speak to the Admiral about finding an assignment somewhere.
Arachnids' Ascent#109.dst: ¿Y qué pensáis hacer ahora vosotros dos? Creo que hablaré con el almirante para que me asigne un destino.
Arachnids' Ascent#109.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#110.src: Hm. I've been thinking a little about... looking into more advanced powder techniques. Something about their magic sticks out to me.
Arachnids' Ascent#110.dst: Mmm. He estado pensando un poco en... estudiar técnicas de polvo más avanzadas. Hay algo en su magia que me llama la atención.
Arachnids' Ascent#110.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#111.src: Oh, really? I thought you would be more into basic fighting, what with our journey to {p}.
Arachnids' Ascent#111.dst: ¿Ah, sí? Pensaba que te iría más el combate sin más, después de nuestro viaje a {p}.
Arachnids' Ascent#111.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#112.src: Yeah... well, I guess I found something a little more interesting along the way. I'll let you know how it all goes.
Arachnids' Ascent#112.dst: Sí... bueno, supongo que por el camino encontré algo un poco más interesante. Ya os contaré qué tal va.
Arachnids' Ascent#112.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#113.src: Keep us updated, Aledar. So, {u}, what are you thinking of doing next?
Arachnids' Ascent#113.dst: Mantennos al tanto, Aledar. Y tú, {u}, ¿qué piensas hacer ahora?
Arachnids' Ascent#113.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#114.src: Not a bad idea! I might join you with that later, once I've decided on things more.
Arachnids' Ascent#114.dst: ¡No es mala idea! Puede que me una a ti más adelante, cuando tenga las cosas más claras.
Arachnids' Ascent#114.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#115.src: Helping people is a good goal. There's bound to be lots of people around who need it.
Arachnids' Ascent#115.dst: Ayudar a la gente es un buen objetivo. Seguro que por aquí hay mucha gente que lo necesita.
Arachnids' Ascent#115.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#116.src: Exploring, huh? That's a good idea. There's plenty to see around here!
Arachnids' Ascent#116.dst: Explorar, ¿eh? Buena idea. ¡Hay mucho que ver por aquí!
Arachnids' Ascent#116.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#117.src: ...And- well, we all came here for a reason. Might as well see the province while we're here, right?
Arachnids' Ascent#117.dst: ...Y, bueno, todos vinimos aquí por algo. Ya que estamos, podríamos conocer la provincia, ¿no?
Arachnids' Ascent#117.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#118.src: Well, if you're staying in the area, maybe we'll cross paths! I'll likely be defending {p} in the short-term.
Arachnids' Ascent#118.dst: Bueno, si te quedas por la zona, ¡quizá nos crucemos! Seguramente defenderé {p} a corto plazo.
Arachnids' Ascent#118.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#119.src: And, well, I'll probably be in the area as well! There's plenty of experts in the area.
Arachnids' Ascent#119.dst: Y yo, bueno, seguramente también andaré por aquí. ¡Hay muchos expertos en la zona!
Arachnids' Ascent#119.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#120.src: Well, hey, there's no shame in that. There's lots to do around here. I'm sure you'll figure it out!
Arachnids' Ascent#120.dst: Bueno, oye, no tiene nada de malo. Hay mucho que hacer por aquí. ¡Seguro que lo averiguas!
Arachnids' Ascent#120.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#121.src: If you need a goal, the next place you might want to visit is {p} {p}, to the north. Maybe pay it a visit when you reach level {~}.
Arachnids' Ascent#121.dst: Si necesitas un objetivo, el próximo lugar que podrías visitar es {p} {p}, al norte. Quizá cuando llegues al nivel {~}.
Arachnids' Ascent#121.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#122.src: ...Well, I'm glad we're all able to be here together. Here's to a long and fulfilling friendship!
Arachnids' Ascent#122.dst: ...Bueno, me alegro de que podamos estar aquí juntos. ¡Por una amistad larga y plena!
Arachnids' Ascent#122.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#123.src: I'll drink to that! To all our future adventures.
Arachnids' Ascent#123.dst: ¡Brindo por ello! Por todas nuestras aventuras futuras.
Arachnids' Ascent#123.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#124.src: ...Oh, {u}! Good to see you. Anything interesting going on with you?
Arachnids' Ascent#124.dst: ...¡Oh, {u}! Me alegro de verte. ¿Te ha pasado algo interesante?
Arachnids' Ascent#124.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#125.src: Me? Well, I've been making little progress... but, nothing too big yet. I'm keeping at it, though!
Arachnids' Ascent#125.dst: ¿Yo? Bueno, he avanzado un poquito... pero nada muy grande aún. ¡Aunque sigo en ello!
Arachnids' Ascent#125.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#126.src: Oh, hello {u}. I'm probably not going to be here for long- I've been assigned to help defend {p} to the south.
Arachnids' Ascent#126.dst: Oh, hola, {u}. Seguramente no estaré aquí mucho tiempo: me han destinado a ayudar a defender {p}, al sur.
Arachnids' Ascent#126.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#127.src: You should come visit, if you have the chance!
Arachnids' Ascent#127.dst: ¡Deberías venir a verme si tienes ocasión!
Arachnids' Ascent#127.speaker: Tasim
